# whatwg-fetch 3.6.20

`fetch.umd.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of the MIT-licensed
[whatwg-fetch](https://github.com/JakeChampion/fetch/tree/v3.6.20) package.

Source: https://unpkg.com/whatwg-fetch@3.6.20/dist/fetch.umd.js

The bundle is embedded in the downloader; installation does not require npm.
The accompanying `LICENSE` applies to the vendored bundle.
